title: NovelAI (novelai/spec/**/*.json)
description: One prompt per JSON file under novelai/spec/, including subfolders. The path relative to novelai/spec/ without .json is the spec id. Output filename_prefix is that id (nested folders preserved). Tag arrays for NovelAI Diffusion txt2img. When omitted, model is nai-diffusion-5-full, sampler is k_euler_ancestral, steps is 28, and scale is 5.

model.description: NovelAI Diffusion API model name. When omitted, nai-diffusion-5-full is used.

image_size.description: Output dimensions (width x height). Official Small/Normal/Large presets: Small 512x768, 768x512, 640x640; Normal 832x1216, 1216x832, 1024x1024; Large 1024x1536, 1536x1024, 1472x1472. Opus Anlas-free generations are Normal or smaller, 28 steps or fewer, and one image per request.

positive.description: Positive prompt tags, joined with ', ' for NovelAI. Empty emits no positive tags.

negative.description: Negative prompt tags, joined with ', ' for NovelAI. Empty emits no negative tags.

sampler.description: NovelAI sampler. When omitted, k_euler_ancestral is used.

steps.description: Sampling steps. When omitted, 28 is used. Opus Anlas-free generations require 28 or fewer.

scale.description: Prompt guidance. When omitted, 5 is used.
